item.title: New Screen Rapidly Detects Mental Illness, SUD, Suicide Risk
item.description: A new assessment tool can quickly screen for multiple psychiatric disorders in minutes with high sensitivity and specificity.

item.title: Prostate Cancer Symptom Severity: Do Doctors Get It Right?
item.description: A study finds physicians often underestimated urinary and bowel symptoms but overestimated sexual symptoms compared with patient reports in men.

item.title: New method to assess aging pace may speed anti-aging breakthroughs
item.description: Twelve candidate indicators, based on studies in mice, could make developing anti-aging interventions faster while offering new insights into age-related conditions.

item.title: Anti-seizure drug fights aggressive childhood brain tumors, study shows
item.description: An existing anti-seizure drug slows the growth of a devastating group of childhood cancers, new Stanford Medicine-led research has shown.
